notes:
New in 0.1.4.1 - crisp pixels:
- Sharp pixels is now the default (Esc > Pixel scaling): every game pixel is the same size on screen. Before, on a 1080p screen one game pixel was 3.75 screen pixels, so some were drawn 3 and some 4 wide. On such screens the game rounds up and crops a few pixels of sky and wall.
- Glow removed from the shader looks (it made soft halos around foam).
- Water effects (light shafts, caustics, glints, refraction) now animate in steps like pixel-art water, and refraction moves whole pixels only: no more shimmer.
- The water is drawn from the water density around each pixel: the surface flickers much less (0.47% -> 0.19% of water pixels per frame after a wave) and there are no small holes inside the water.
- Colours inside the water are smoothed: no checkerboard speckle.
- Foam rework stays planned for 1.7 (final water look).
